bullets.bullet_text: Implemented SOC 2-aligned AWS controls enabling regulated insurers to safely adopt analytics and ML capabilities, establishing a trust and governance foundation for enterprise platform deployment.

Built a shared-responsibility operating-model framework clarifying AWS versus insurer-owned control boundaries, creating a repeatable pattern for guiding partner-led deployments through regulated environments.
Led AWS modernization execution for monolithic policy administration and insurance platform workloads, directly overseeing technical delivery of complex legacy-to-cloud transitions.
